name: Caps lock indicator
author: Mero J.
description: A dot that lights up while Caps Lock is on

barWidget.description: A small dot that lights up while Caps Lock is on. Refreshes instantly via a self-registered Caps_Lock bind and falls back to a light poll.

schema.label: Dot color
schema.description: Color of the dot while Caps Lock is on. Leave "auto" to use the bar's active (urgent) color. Any CSS color, e.g. #ff4444.

schema.label: Dot size
schema.description: Diameter of the dot in pixels.

schema.label: Hide when off
schema.description: Hide the dot completely while Caps Lock is off instead of showing it dimmed.

schema.label: Dim opacity (%)
schema.description: Brightness of the dot while Caps Lock is off, from 0 to 100.
